# Adventure Smiles Pediatric Dentistry

> Adventure Smiles Pediatric Dentistry is a child-friendly dental practice in Las Vegas, Nevada specializing in preventive care, emergency services, and comprehensive oral health for children.

Located in Las Vegas with multiple service locations including Spring Valley, Rhodes Ranch, Arden, and Summerlin, Adventure Smiles is led by Dr. Noura Rezapour and provides pediatric dental services using modern techniques like composite fillings and dental sealants. The practice emphasizes patient education and emergency care for children's dental needs.
